## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Java</b> (spoiler) · <code>0392-is-subsequence.java</code></summary>

```java
class Solution {
    public boolean isSubsequence(String s, String t) {
        int j = 0;
        for(int i = 0; i < t.length(); i++){
            if(j < s.length()){
                if(s.charAt(j) == t.charAt(i)){
                    j++;
                }
            }
        }

        if(j == s.length()) return true;
        else return false;
        
    }
}
```

</details>
